caption: Routing and Record Sheet, page 1 of the CIA Inspector General's memorandum on behavioral drugs, February 5, 1975.
alt: Photocopied CIA routing form marked SECRET and NATIONAL SECURITY INFORMATION, headed ROUTING AND RECORD SHEET, from the Inspector General to Mr. Knoche, with a handwritten note reading 'for the telephone book' and routing stamps.
credit: Central Intelligence Agency, Office of the Inspector General / CIA CREST collection, via Internet Archive
note: Page 1 of the declassified memo PDF (CIA reading room document 01434878), rendered at 150 dpi. Shows the SECRET classification marking, routing boxes, and a handwritten annotation.
